about: The AE battle rifle pack: CMT's TSC:E 1.4.1 rifle (art and sounds, credited) made into the approved donor map and the pack. make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line.

stock_derived.ae\\packs\\battle_rifle\\hud\\br_ammo: layout numbers set by AE, from the stock assault rifle HUD's structure: positions, sizes and references (hud_tag.py), no art

source.name: CMT's The Silent Cartographer: Evolved 1.4.1c source release

tools.ffmpeg: n9.0.2 (decodes the Ogg Vorbis permutations to 16-bit PCM)
tools.art: Python 3.14 with Pillow 12.2.0 and numpy 2.4.4 drew the art pinned below (each by its decoded pixels, mode and size, not by its file)

steps.why: the donor map: Blood Gulch's scenario without vehicles, the rifle in its weapon palette

a shader of the rifle's own model: its reflection cube map is a campaign map's (levels\a10\bitmaps\cube map glass), which no multiplayer map has; it names the stock cyborg's mirror cube map instead, which every stock multiplayer map has, so the pack carries no cube map of the game's
the Xbox's model format (Invader's gbxmodel to model)
the Xbox's model format; its parts had no compressed vertices, which the Xbox's build needs
the Xbox model; the pickup and HUD message indices the stock assault rifle's (CMT's point into CMT's own HUD texts)

the swap and pickup prompts' picture of the rifle: a sprite sheet holding only our own drawing (hud_sheet.py), its one sequence and sprite written by the bitmap compiler; the sprite is placed by its top left corner
CMT's interface keeps only its crosshairs; the ammunition panel is the child HUD
the crosshair (our two-part reticle: its ring and its ticks, which spread a shot) in CE's colour, red on target; the scope: our sharp lines, the mask without its ring, the ring its own item

the held rifle's collision is the stock assault rifle's; the melee the stock assault rifle's, its damage and response tags left to the map (on every stock multiplayer map): 40 to 60 a blow, 1.4 against a Spartan's shield and body, as every stock weapon's (CMT's melee took 30 flat at 1.0: about five blows from the front where a stock weapon takes two or three)

a small muzzle flash (the owner, from his screenshots and video): in first person the quick ball alone at 0.8 of CMT's size, every flare off (the long one ran from the muzzle to the reticle); in third person the sprites at 0.4 (the owner: big beside the pistol's) and one of the three long flares kept; the sound, smoke, casings and light as they were

approved_reference.about: the donor the owner approved (v6e): the build the departures are measured from. The pack is compared with it and may differ only in the tags named here (by the donor's tag names)
